Definition: from G2095 and G4698; well compassioned, i.e. sympathetic:--pitiful, tender-hearted.
BiblicalUsage: eúsplanchnos is the word for pitiful, tender-hearted. In Ephesians 4:32, the text says "tenderhearted."
TheologicalSignificance: I read eúsplanchnos plainly — it means pitiful, tender-hearted, and I do not build a doctrine on it.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
